insight_1.name: Partial Implementation is Worse Than Failure
insight_1.observation: Claiming to do investigation but stopping halfway creates false confidence
insight_1.impact: Team thinks problem is solved → doesn't allocate time to fix → incident later

insight_2.name: Implementation Must Match Resolution
insight_2.observation: Voting for KEEP_INVESTIGATE but only doing KEEP creates drift
insight_2.impact: Technical debt accumulates because nobody remembers the plan
insight_2.framework_revelation: Coherence trajectory shows flat line instead of improvement

insight_3.name: Completeness Matters More Than Speed
insight_3.observation: Right path takes longer but reaches 100% coherence
insight_3.impact: Fast partial path feels good short-term but fails at week 8
insight_3.framework_revelation: Cost of completion vs cost of incident is 10:1

insight_4.name: Documentation = Accountability
insight_4.observation: Correct path includes written investigation report
insight_4.impact: Prevents 'I thought we fixed this' 6 months later
insight_4.framework_revelation: Ledger tracks what was promised vs what was delivered

conclusion: Framework reveals incomplete implementations through coherence metrics. Partial work produces false confidence then crisis. Complete work reaches 100% coherence gradually but sustainably.
